title: Three Terms and One Short Surface
subtitle: 物理力学 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 物理力学（科学与技术·物理与力学）
meta: 主题语境：物理力学（科学与技术·物理与力学）　|　核心词汇：friction　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 friction 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the physicist ① measured a friction that no student in the lab would have named, and he said the measuring was the whole of the term. The ② friction, meaning the rubbing itself and not the heat, ran three terms and stayed unnamed in the book; a friction, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ friction in that lab had the same short surface beside it, and the ④ friction at the far bench, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A friction, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; the physicist said the naming is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the friction was the whole of the matter, meaning the disagreement and not the rubbing. The ⑥ friction, meaning the disagreement and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody names; friction, he said, is either something you measure or the only word that means both a rubbing and a disagreement. He said the disagreement is the part they remember.

By 1974 the ⑦ friction had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short surface. The ⑧ friction of the whole thing, the physicist wrote in April, was one lab and three terms of naming; friction, he said, is either the one at the far bench or the reason you learned to name. He said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ friction I remember is the one named in the plan, which closed in 1976 and is still described as the quietest in the lab. A ⑩ friction, my mother said in 1978, is the only one that improves by being named; every friction, she said, is a disagreement that has agreed to look like a rubbing. She said the disagreement was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 摩擦（指实验室里每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 摩擦（指那一处本身，与热量相对）
C. 固定搭配：measure a friction 测量一处摩擦
D. n. 摩擦（指留给孩子们的那一种）
E. n. 摩擦（抽象总称，指一间实验室的测摩擦之事）
F. n. 摩擦（指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一处）
G. n. 矛盾；不和（friction between people，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）
H. n. 不和（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）

answers.why: measure a friction 意为“测量一处摩擦”，1967 年那位物理学家测了一处实验室里没有一位学生肯说出名字的摩擦。
friction 意为“摩擦”，指那一处本身而不是热量，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被说出名字。
friction 意为“摩擦”，指实验室里每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一块矮矮的板面。
friction 意为“摩擦”，指留给孩子们的那一种，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
friction 意为“矛盾、不和”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，叔叔说这份不和就是那件事的全部。
friction 意为“不和”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那处摩擦，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
friction 意为“摩擦”，指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一处，到 1974 年这一处成了计划里的一行。
friction 意为“摩擦”，物理学家四月写道，整件事的测摩擦之事是一间实验室和三个学期的说出名字。
friction 意为“摩擦”，我记得的是计划里被说出名字的那一处，1976 年结束了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一处。
friction 为抽象总称，母亲 1978 年说，一处摩擦是唯一会因为被好好说出名字而变得更好的东西。
